description: Unique identifier of a sales opportunity. Primary key.
Pipeline stage: Prospecting and Engaging are open; Won and Lost are closed.
Revenue of the deal once Won. Expected empty for open and Lost deals. Use for revenue and win value.
Date the opportunity entered the Engaging stage.
Date the opportunity was Won or Lost. Must not be earlier than engage_date.
Foreign key to accounts.account. The customer company.
Foreign key to sales_teams.sales_agent. The owner of the deal.
Manager of the sales agent. Use to roll up performance by manager.
Regional office of the agent. Use to roll up performance by region.
List price of the product. Not the realised deal value.
